finding_text: A user says Backspace corrupts the submitted text if the last character is an emoji.
evidence: The operator typed X, U+1F600, Backspace, Y, Enter in the pipe TUI.
PowerShell and Git Bash both persisted the code units 0058 D83D 0059. An earlier unedited submission appeared intact.
source: 4eb2db23, Windows ConPTY smoke in both shells; aad8e4f1 regression

finding_text: A reviewer says that bracketed paste of a CRLF block into the Windows pipe TUI submits two separate turns.
evidence: The captured input was paste-start, a 732-character first line, CR LF, a second line, paste-end. The operator then pressed Enter once.
The history file grew by one entry. Decoding that entry yielded the first line, one LF, and the exact second line.
source: 4eb2db23, verified by Windows ConPTY history artifact in both shells

finding_text: Operators preparing to add a model registry want to type a short, project-defined alias for a provider/model pair in the existing selector.
evidence: In the preceding release the documented selector accepted a provider/model pair or a bare model under the current provider.
A session using the full pair selected it successfully. The project configuration had no alias table in that release.

finding_text: A reviewer reports that a failed write during history persistence looks exactly like a successful one to the terminal user.
evidence: In the recorded run the history destination was unwritable. A later turn could still run.
The save handler caught the filesystem exception and returned normally. The captured transcript contained neither a save-failure message nor a change to the saved history.
source: d26db2c5, PR #1426 red/green test receipt on the preceding implementation

finding_text: An operator reports that selecting an uninstalled Ollama model and sending a prompt terminates the chat process, forcing a restart.
evidence: The request returned HTTP 404 with the missing model name. The terminal then accepted a selection for a locally installed model.
In that same process, the selected model answered a prompt and recalled a ticket code on the following turn.
source: 4eb2db23, live missing-model and follow-up Ollama session

finding_text: A project operator asks for an in-session command that discovers available provider installations so they can compare local environments.
evidence: The release under review ran chat through the pipe backend. Its help listed model selection and editing commands.
An operator could use the documented chat commands. Discovering installed providers required inspecting the machine outside that session.
